تقتلعوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَلِعُوا (taqtaliʕū) /taq.ta.li.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# تُقْتَلَعُوا (tuqtalaʕū) /tuq.ta.la.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
